nodes.description: AMA constructor: sets name/symbol, mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner = msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to Uniswap router.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
Core transfer path: allowance check, ensure() whitelist gate, and unchecked balance/allowance mutations of balanceOf and _onSaleNum.
Internal whitelist gate: passes when _from/_to is owner, the UNI router, the computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale, otherwise falls through to condition().
Internal sale-policy check based on _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balanceOf[spender] and canSale[spender].
Owner-only initialisation of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Owner-only batch airdrop loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist field.
Pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, token pair and init-code hash.
ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom: moves balances and decreases allowance with SafeMath.
Internal ERC20 balance movement using SafeMath sub/add, emits Transfer.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal burn decreasing _balances and _totalSupply.
ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve.
Increases spender allowance via SafeMath.add.
Decreases spender allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Returns msg.sender as address payable.
Overflow-checked addition.
Underflow-checked subtraction.
Overflow-checked multiplication.
Encodes token.transfer and routes through callOptionalReturn.
Encodes token.transferFrom and routes through callOptionalReturn.
Encodes token.approve with non-zero allowance guard and routes through callOptionalReturn.
Performs an unchecked low-level call to the token address and decodes optional return data.
Privileged owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by all require(msg.sender == owner) gates.
Public mapping of token balances mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping, decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Whitelist flag consulted by ensure and set by _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address, configured by init.
Minimum sale amount, configured by init.
Maximum sale amount, configured by init.
Trade address whitelisted by ensure, set by setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals = 18 used in scaling mixes in _mints and init.
Constant Uniswap router address used in the ensure whitelist.
Private ERC20 balance mapping.
Private nested ERC20 allowance mapping.
Private ERC20 total supply.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, transfer initiator and mint recipient.
delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executing untrusted code in AMA storage context.
Low-level call to a caller-influenced token address with optional return-data decoding.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath underflow protection.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath.
total = _value * _tos.length and balance mutations executed without SafeMath; total can overflow.
Token source address argument of AMA.transferFrom.
Token destination address argument of AMA.transferFrom.
Amount argument of AMA.transferFrom.
Source address argument of ensure.
Destination address argument of ensure.
Amount argument of ensure.
Address argument of condition used to look up _onSaleNum.
Amount argument of condition compared against _minSale/_maxSale.
Address argument of _mints receiving balance and whitelist flag.
Mint amount argument of _mints, scaled by 10**decimals.
Number of allowed sales assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount assigned to _minSale.
Maximum sale amount assigned to _maxSale.
Recipient address array of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend.
New trade address assigned to tradeAddress.
Target address of the delegatecall.
Calldata executed via delegatecall.

Loop-local recipient address in batchSend.
Local address computed by pairFor and compared in the ensure whitelist.

edges.reason: AMA.transfer delegates execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
transferFrom requires the ensure() whitelist check to pass.
ensure falls back to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked -= and += operations.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the owner-privileged caller.
callOptionalReturn performs the unchecked low-level call to the token.
safeTransfer routes the encoded transfer selector through callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom routes the encoded transferFrom selector through callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove routes the encoded approve selector through callOptionalReturn.
ERC20.transfer calls _transfer for the actual balance movement.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting allowance.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
ERC20.approve calls _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the incremented value.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decremented value.
ERC20.transfer resolves the sender through _msgSender (msg.sender).
ERC20.approve resolves the owner through _msgSender (msg.sender).
_transfer credits the recipient using SafeMath.add.
_transfer debits the sender using SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.transferFrom subtracts the allowance using SafeMath.sub.
_mint increases supply and balance using SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases balance and supply using SafeMath.sub.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and the allowance[msg.sender] key in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared to owner and the hardcoded minter address in _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner to configure sale limits in init.
msg.sender must equal owner to run the batchSend airdrop.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
ensure whitelists the owner address via _from == owner || _to == owner.
ensure whitelists any address flagged in canSale.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address.
condition compares _onSaleNum against _saleNum.
condition checks _value against _minSale.
condition checks _value against _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] for a privileged caller.
_mints grants the canSale whitelist flag.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init writes _minSale from the token argument.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
Constructor scales the supply with decimals.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_from selects the allowance and balance slots read and written by transferFrom.
_to receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted and added without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
_from participates in the whitelist comparisons of ensure.
_to participates in the owner whitelist comparison of ensure.
_value is forwarded to condition by ensure.
_from indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
spender is the account credited and whitelisted by _mints.
addedValue becomes the new balance of spender in _mints.
saleNum configures the _saleNum sale cap in init.
token configures the _minSale floor in init.
maxToken configures the _maxSale ceiling in init.
_tos.length multiplies _value when computing the total in batchSend.
_value is multiplied and repeatedly added into balances without SafeMath.
addr is written into the whitelisted tradeAddress slot.
a is the target address of the owner-controlled delegatecall.
b is the attacker-controlled calldata executed via delegatecall.
batchSend derives the local total from _value and _tos.length.
batchSend reads each recipient into the loop-local _to.
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local _UNI used for whitelisting.
The overflow-prone local total is consumed by the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
Arbitrary delegatecall code runs in AMA context and can re-enter transferFrom before state effects settle.
The low-level call to an untrusted token can call back into SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn before return data is validated.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the balance/allowance key of AMA.transferFrom, so it collapses into that function node.
Parameter _to only exists to receive the balance inside AMA.transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by the unchecked arithmetic of AMA.transferFrom.
Parameter _from is only used for the whitelist comparisons inside ensure.
Parameter _to is only used for the owner comparison inside ensure.
Parameter _value only feeds condition() from ensure.
Parameter _from is only the _onSaleNum index used by condition.
Parameter _value is only compared with the sale bounds inside condition.
Parameter spender is only the credited/whitelisted account of _mints.
Parameter addedValue is only the minted amount assigned inside _mints.
Parameter saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init.
Parameter token is only stored into _minSale by init.
Parameter maxToken is only stored into _maxSale by init.
Parameter _tos is only the recipient array iterated in batchSend.
Parameter _value is only the per-recipient amount used in batchSend arithmetic.
Parameter addr is only assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is only the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
Local total exists only to feed the overflow-prone multiplication/check of batchSend's unchecked arithmetic.
Loop-local _to is a transient alias for entries of _tos inside batchSend.
Local _UNI is a transient pairFor result used only by the ensure whitelist check.
